items.headline: Tried Qwen3.6-27B-UD-Q6_K_XL.gguf with CloudeCode, well I can't believe but it is usable
items.summary: So I tried to run Qwen3-27B-UD-Q6_K_XL.gguf with 200K context on my RTX 5090 using llama.cpp. I'm getting around 50 tok/s, which is fine I guess, I don't really know this stuff so it might be improvable. But what I want to say is, I haven't tried local models for coding for quite a long time, and hell, I can't believe we're at the point where it's actually usable? Of course not the same first class experience as Opus 4.7, but damn, we are getting closer and closer. https://preview.redd.it/

items.headline: Me: "It lasted 8 months." Claude: "Well, it depends on how long it lasted." Anyone found a way to fix this?
items.summary: I've noticed a pattern lately where Claude flat-out ignores specific details I include in my prompt, then speculates about the very thing I already told it. items.headline: SWE-chat: Coding Agent Interactions From Real Users in the Wild
items.summary:
arXiv:2604.20779v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: AI coding agents are being adopted at scale, yet we lack empirical evidence on how people actually use them and how much of their output is useful in practice. We present SWE-chat, the first large-scale dataset of real coding agent sessions collected from open-source developers in the wild.
